title: Quantitative Proteomics Based on iTRAQ Reveal that Nitidine Chloride Induces Apoptosis by Activating JNK/c-Jun Signaling in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Cells.
authors: Chen, Shipeng; Liao, Yinan; Lv, Jinyan; Hou, Huaxin; Feng, Jie
one_liner_zh: 该文用iTRAQ定量蛋白质组学和分子对接研究氯化两面针碱在肝癌细胞中通过JNK/c-Jun信号诱导凋亡，虽涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The aim of the present study was to investigate the cytotoxic effects and underlying molecular mechanisms of nitidine chloride (NC) in hepatocellular carcinoma cells via quantitative proteomics. MTT assays were used to detect the inhibitory effects of NC in Bel-7402 liver cancer cells, and the number of apoptotic cells was measured by flow cytometry. Quantitative proteomics technology based on iTRAQ was used to discover differential expressed proteins after NC treatment, and bioinformatic techniques were further used to screen potential targets of NC. Molecular docking was applied to evaluate the docking activity of NC with possible upstream proteins, and their expression was detected at the mRNA and protein levels by quantitative reverse transcription PCR and western blotting. NC inhibited the proliferation of Bel-7402 cells after 24 h of treatment and stimulated apoptosis in vitro. The proteomics experiment showed that NC triggers mitochondrial damage in HCC cells and transcription factor AP-1 (c-Jun) may be a potential target of NC (fold change = 4.36 +/- 0.23). Molecular docking results revealed the highest docking score of NC with c-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK), one of the upstream proteins of c-Jun. Moreover, the mRNA and protein expression of c-Jun and JNK were significantly increased after NC treatment (p < 0.05). These findings indicate that NC significantly induced mitochondrial damage in HCC cells, and induced apoptosis by activating JNK/c-Jun signaling.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过定量蛋白质组学探讨氯化两面针碱（nitidine chloride, NC）对人肝癌细胞的细胞毒性作用及其潜在分子机制。采用MTT法检测NC对Bel-7402肝癌细胞的抑制作用，并通过流式细胞术测量凋亡细胞数量。基于iTRAQ的定量蛋白质组学技术用于发现NC处理后的差异表达蛋白，并进一步利用生物信息学技术筛选NC的潜在靶点。应用分子对接评估NC与可能上游蛋白的对接活性，并通过定量逆转录PCR和western blotting在mRNA和蛋白水平检测其表达。NC处理24小时后抑制了Bel-7402细胞的增殖，并在体外刺激了细胞凋亡。蛋白质组学实验显示，NC触发肝癌细胞线粒体损伤，转录因子AP-1（c-Jun）可能是NC的潜在靶点（倍数变化 = 4.36 ± 0.23）。分子对接结果显示，NC与c-Jun上游蛋白之一c-Jun N末端激酶（JNK）的对接得分最高。此外，NC处理后c-Jun和JNK的mRNA及蛋白表达显著增加（p < 0.05）。这些发现表明，NC显著诱导肝癌细胞线粒体损伤，并通过激活JNK/c-Jun信号通路诱导细胞凋亡。
